values.content:
=You are an expert invoice data extractor. Extract invoice data from the text below and return ONLY a valid JSON object. No explanation. No markdown fences. No extra text.

Return exactly this structure:
{
  "invoice_number": "",
  "invoice_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "due_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "document_type": "INVOICE",
  "currency": "",
  "purchase_order_number": "",
  "payment_terms": "",
  "notes": "",
  "supplier": {
    "name": "",
    "address": "",
    "country_code": "",
    "vat_number": "",
    "iban": "",
    "swift": ""
  },
  "buyer": {
    "name": "",
    "address": "",
    "country_code": "",
    "vat_number": ""
  },
  "line_items": [
    {
      "line_number": 1,
      "description": "",
      "quantity": 0,
      "unit": "",
      "unit_price": 0,
      "vat_rate": 0,
      "vat_amount": 0,
      "line_total_excl_vat": 0,
      "line_total_incl_vat": 0
    }
  ],
  "subtotal_excl_vat": 0,
  "total_vat": 0,
  "total_incl_vat": 0
}

Rules:
- country_code must be ISO 2-letter code (KR=Korea, TW=Taiwan, MY=Malaysia etc)
- invoice_date must be YYYY-MM-DD format
- All amounts must be numbers not strings
- line_total_excl_vat = quantity x unit_price
- total_incl_vat = subtotal_excl_vat + total_vat

Invoice text:
{{ $json.extractedText }}

parameters.jsCode:
const data = $input.item.json;
const inv = data.invoice;

const xmlEscape = (val) => {
  if (val === null || val === undefined) return '';
  return String(val)
    .replace(/&/g, '&')
    .replace(/</g, '<')
    .replace(/>/g, '>')
    .replace(/"/g, '"')
    .replace(/'/g, ''');
};

const lineItemsXML = (inv.line_items || []).map((item, idx) => `
    <InvoiceLine>
      <ID>${xmlEscape(item.line_number || (idx + 1))}</ID>
      <Note>${xmlEscape(item.notes || '')}</Note>
      <InvoicedQuantity unitCode="${xmlEscape(item.unit || 'EA')}">${xmlEscape(item.quantity)}</InvoicedQuantity>
      <LineExtensionAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(item.line_total_excl_vat)}</LineExtensionAmount>
      <TaxTotal>
        <TaxAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(item.vat_amount || 0)}</TaxAmount>
        <TaxSubtotal>
          <TaxableAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(item.line_total_excl_vat)}</TaxableAmount>
          <TaxAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(item.vat_amount || 0)}</TaxAmount>
          <TaxCategory><ID>S</ID><Percent>${xmlEscape(item.vat_rate || 0)}</Percent><TaxScheme><ID>VAT</ID></TaxScheme></TaxCategory>
        </TaxSubtotal>
      </TaxTotal>
      <Item><Description>${xmlEscape(item.description)}</Description><Name>${xmlEscape(item.description)}</Name></Item>
      <Price><PriceAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(item.unit_price)}</PriceAmount></Price>
    </InvoiceLine>`).join('');

const zbXML = `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Invoice xmlns="urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:Invoice-2"
         xmlns:cac="urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:CommonAggregateComponents-2"
         xmlns:cbc="urn:oasis:names:specification:ubl:schema:xsd:CommonBasicComponents-2">
  <cbc:UBLVersionID>2.1</cbc:UBLVersionID>
  <cbc:CustomizationID>urn:cen.eu:en16931:2017#compliant#urn:fdc:peppol.eu:2017:poacc:billing:3.0</cbc:CustomizationID>
  <cbc:ProfileID>urn:fdc:peppol.eu:2017:poacc:billing:01:1.0</cbc:ProfileID>
  <cbc:ID>${xmlEscape(inv.invoice_number)}</cbc:ID>
  <cbc:IssueDate>${xmlEscape(inv.invoice_date)}</cbc:IssueDate>
  <cbc:DueDate>${xmlEscape(inv.due_date || '')}</cbc:DueDate>
  <cbc:InvoiceTypeCode>${inv.document_type === 'CREDIT_NOTE' ? '381' : '380'}</cbc:InvoiceTypeCode>
  <cbc:Note>${xmlEscape(inv.notes || '')}</cbc:Note>
  <cbc:DocumentCurrencyCode>${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}</cbc:DocumentCurrencyCode>
  <cbc:BuyerReference>${xmlEscape(inv.purchase_order_number || '')}</cbc:BuyerReference>
  ${inv.purchase_order_number ? `<cac:OrderReference><cbc:ID>${xmlEscape(inv.purchase_order_number)}</cbc:ID></cac:OrderReference>` : ''}
  <cac:AccountingSupplierParty><cac:Party>
    <cac:PartyName><cbc:Name>${xmlEscape(inv.supplier?.name)}</cbc:Name></cac:PartyName>
    <cac:PostalAddress><cbc:StreetName>${xmlEscape(inv.supplier?.address)}</cbc:StreetName><cac:Country><cbc:IdentificationCode>${xmlEscape(inv.supplier?.country_code)}</cbc:IdentificationCode></cac:Country></cac:PostalAddress>
    <cac:PartyTaxScheme><cbc:CompanyID>${xmlEscape(inv.supplier?.vat_number)}</cbc:CompanyID><cac:TaxScheme><cbc:ID>VAT</cbc:ID></cac:TaxScheme></cac:PartyTaxScheme>
    <cac:PartyLegalEntity><cbc:RegistrationName>${xmlEscape(inv.supplier?.name)}</cbc:RegistrationName></cac:PartyLegalEntity>
  </cac:Party></cac:AccountingSupplierParty>
  <cac:AccountingCustomerParty><cac:Party>
    <cac:PartyName><cbc:Name>${xmlEscape(inv.buyer?.name)}</cbc:Name></cac:PartyName>
    <cac:PostalAddress><cbc:StreetName>${xmlEscape(inv.buyer?.address)}</cbc:StreetName><cac:Country><cbc:IdentificationCode>${xmlEscape(inv.buyer?.country_code)}</cbc:IdentificationCode></cac:Country></cac:PostalAddress>
    <cac:PartyTaxScheme><cbc:CompanyID>${xmlEscape(inv.buyer?.vat_number)}</cbc:CompanyID><cac:TaxScheme><cbc:ID>VAT</cbc:ID></cac:TaxScheme></cac:PartyTaxScheme>
    <cac:PartyLegalEntity><cbc:RegistrationName>${xmlEscape(inv.buyer?.name)}</cbc:RegistrationName></cac:PartyLegalEntity>
  </cac:Party></cac:AccountingCustomerParty>
  <cac:PaymentMeans>
    <cbc:PaymentMeansCode>30</cbc:PaymentMeansCode>
    <cbc:PaymentDueDate>${xmlEscape(inv.due_date || '')}</cbc:PaymentDueDate>
    <cac:PayeeFinancialAccount><cbc:ID>${xmlEscape(inv.supplier?.iban || '')}</cbc:ID><cac:FinancialInstitutionBranch><cbc:ID>${xmlEscape(inv.supplier?.swift || '')}</cbc:ID></cac:FinancialInstitutionBranch></cac:PayeeFinancialAccount>
  </cac:PaymentMeans>
  ${inv.payment_terms ? `<cac:PaymentTerms><cbc:Note>${xmlEscape(inv.payment_terms)}</cbc:Note></cac:PaymentTerms>` : ''}
  <cac:TaxTotal>
    <cbc:TaxAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(inv.total_vat || 0)}</cbc:TaxAmount>
    <cac:TaxSubtotal>
      <cbc:TaxableAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(inv.subtotal_excl_vat || 0)}</cbc:TaxableAmount>
      <cbc:TaxAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(inv.total_vat || 0)}</cbc:TaxAmount>
      <cac:TaxCategory><cbc:ID>S</cbc:ID><cac:TaxScheme><cbc:ID>VAT</cbc:ID></cac:TaxScheme></cac:TaxCategory>
    </cac:TaxSubtotal>
  </cac:TaxTotal>
  <cac:LegalMonetaryTotal>
    <cbc:LineExtensionAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(inv.subtotal_excl_vat || 0)}</cbc:LineExtensionAmount>
    <cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(inv.subtotal_excl_vat || 0)}</cbc:TaxExclusiveAmount>
    <cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(inv.total_incl_vat || 0)}</cbc:TaxInclusiveAmount>
    <cbc:PayableAmount currencyID="${xmlEscape(inv.currency)}">${xmlEscape(inv.total_incl_vat || 0)}</cbc:PayableAmount>
  </cac:LegalMonetaryTotal>
  ${lineItemsXML}
</Invoice>`;

return {
  json: {
    ...data,
    zbXML,
    xmlFileName: `ZB_${inv.invoice_number || data.runId}_${inv.invoice_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.xml`
  }
};

const data = $('Validate Invoice Data').item.json;
const inv = data.invoice;

return {
  json: {
    runId: data.runId,
    fileName: data.fileName,
    fileId: data.fileId,
    sourcePdfUrl: data.sourcePdfUrl,
    invoiceNumber: inv.invoice_number || 'UNKNOWN',
    supplierName: inv.supplier?.name || 'UNKNOWN',
    buyerName: inv.buyer?.name || 'UNKNOWN',
    invoiceDate: inv.invoice_date || '',
    currency: inv.currency || '',
    totalInclVAT: inv.total_incl_vat || 0,
    extractionMethod: data.extractionMethod,
    triggeredAt: data.triggeredAt,
    completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    status: 'SUCCESS',
    warnings: data.validation?.warnings || [],
    warningCount: data.validation?.warningCount || 0,
    errorCount: 0,
    errors: []
  }
};

nodes.name: Move Failed PDF to Exception Folder

parameters.content:
## DUAL-PATH OCR ENGINE

This switch automatically detects if the invoice is a digital PDF or a flat scan/image.


Action Required: Open the HTTP Request2 node and connect your Mistral API credentials to handle the scanned fallback stream.

## SUCCESS DASHBOARD LOG

Appends data cleanly whenever an invoice passes verification.


Action Required: Connect your Google Sheets account. Paste your copied Master Spreadsheet ID into the "Document" field. Ensure the sheet name matches your tab title.

## EXCEPTION LOG

Tracks validation failures and structural extraction errors.

Action Required: Map this to the same Spreadsheet ID used above, but target your specific "Exceptions" tab layout.

## DRIVE MAINTENANC

Isolates corrupt or unreadable files to keep your primary input folder clean and prevent processing loops.

Action Required: Connect Google Drive credentials. Provide your dedicated "Exceptions" folder ID in the Parent Folder field.

## WORKFLOW ENTRY POINT

This node automatically listens for new files uploaded to your primary invoices folder.

Action Required:

Connect your Google Drive account credentials.

Select the specific folder where you will drop incoming invoice PDFs or images.

Ensure the output property is set to provide file data so downstream paths can read the text or send it to Mistral OCR.
